flammable_liquids.quote: TABLE 2.6.1 Criteria for flammable liquids Category Criteria 1 Flash point < 23 oC and initial boiling point ≤ 35 oC 2 Flash point < 23 oC and initial boiling point > 35 oC 3 Flash point ≥ 23 oC and ≤ 60 oC

notes: For the purpose of this Regulation gas oils, diesel and light heating oils having a flash point between ≥ 55 oC and ≤ 75 oC may be regarded as Category 3.
